_doc: make_mob.py / build_mobs.py config. glb: under assets/custom-mobs (or $RAN_MOB_MODELS). tag: file prefix (unique, [a-z0-9_]). id: [main, sub] crow id. crow: npc|mob. template: crow cloned for stats/AI/drops. height: model height in game units before chf_scale (a player is ~20). chf_scale: DxSkinCharData m_fScale (render scale). clips: role -> glTF animation name (idle/walk/run/attack/shock/die; missing roles fall back to the idle anim in game). in_place: roles whose root drift is removed. strikes: hit times as fractions of the attack clip. yaw: extra turn in degrees if the model does not face glTF +Z.

trojan_horse.name: Trojan Horse
trojan_horse.desc: A wooden horse as tall as a temple. The hatch in its belly is open.

rift_zombie.name: Rift Zombie
rift_zombie.desc: A drowned sailor the Rift would not let rest.

rift_ghoul.name: Rift Ghoul
rift_ghoul.desc: A goblin ghoul that crawled out of the Underworld through the Rift.

rift_skeleton.name: Skeleton Warrior
rift_skeleton.desc: A fallen hoplite of Troy, still guarding a city that is long gone.

rift_dragon.name: Bone Dragon
rift_dragon.desc: The skeleton of a dragon, held together by the Rift's will.

colossal_titan.name: Colossal Titan
colossal_titan.desc: It screams, and the sky over the Rift cracks.
